changes.summary: Re-verified authored rating criteria, process rules, presumptives, secondary mappings, DBQ guidance, and corrections guidance against eCFR Title 38 after the 2026-07-13 title amendment. That amendment (FR 2026-14084) was a Loan Guaranty civil monetary penalties inflation notice with no Part 3/4 rating or eligibility impact; rule content fingerprint unchanged.
Established the first fingerprinted release baseline for authored rating criteria, process rules, presumptives, secondary mappings, DBQ guidance, corrections guidance, and vendor rule tables.
